header.written: The words are French and the pairing is this corpus own. Neither is taken from any release.
header.modified: A reading of at most 4 morae is bound to one noun, no nearer than 0.2 to another anchor and no further than 0.5 from its reading. The readings a character teaches are served first, the readings a word teaches next, and what neither pass could serve is asked again of the words under 1 occurrence per million.
header.shape: reading to the word standing for it, that word phonemes as the lexicon derives them, and how common it is per million
